title: VERaiPHY -- Validation & Evaluation for Robust AI in PHYsics
abstract: arXiv:2608.17724v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern machine learning is leading to substantial gains in precision, flexibility, and computational efficiency in fundamental physics. Statistical validation, uncertainty quantification, and robustness assessment are less systematically addressed. The VERaiPHY initiative (Validation & Evaluation for Robust AI in PHYsics) is a series of articles developed within the PHYSTAT programme, aimed at establishing statistical standards for the development, evaluation, and deployment of ML techniques. Each article focuses on a specific methodological domain from a statistics perspective and clarifies statistical questions, tests, and the interpretation of results. This opening article establishes the probabilistic, statistical, and machine learning foundations that the later contributions assume, together with the notation used throughout.

translated_title: VERaiPHY——物理学中稳健人工智能的验证与评估
translated_abstract: 现代机器学习在基础物理学中显著提升了精度、灵活性和计算效率，但统计验证、不确定性量化和稳健性评估的系统性研究相对不足。VERaiPHY倡议（物理学中稳健人工智能的验证与评估）是PHYSTAT项目下开发的一系列文章，旨在为机器学习技术的开发、评估和部署建立统计标准。每篇文章从统计学角度聚焦于一个特定方法论领域，并阐明统计问题、检验方法及结果解释。本文作为开篇，确立了后续贡献所依赖的概率、统计和机器学习基础，以及贯穿全文使用的符号体系。
tldr: 本文是VERaiPHY系列的开篇，旨在为物理学中机器学习技术建立统计标准，奠定概率、统计和机器学习的基础框架。
en_tdlr: This opening article of the VERaiPHY series establishes foundational probabilistic, statistical, and machine learning frameworks to set statistical standards for ML in physics.
